name: move_node
description: Move a node to a different parent in a scene and optionally control its position among siblings.

dry_run.description: Preview only: do the work, report it, write nothing. Default false.

new_parent_path.description: Path to the new parent node (. for root)

node_path.description: Path to the node to move

sibling_index.description: Optional position among siblings (0 = first child). Omit or -1 to append.
